banks.name: GeneralUser GS
banks.author: S. Christian Collins
banks.description: Complete General MIDI and Roland GS compatible sampled bank; the default. It is not a Roland ROM bank or an SC-55/MT-32 emulator.

banks.name: TimGM6mb
banks.author: Tim Brechbill; MuseScore distribution
banks.description: Small complete General MIDI bank retained by the official historical MuseScore source. A neutral low-memory alternative.

sources.name: Munt / MT-32
sources.description: Real MT-32/CM-32L device emulation, using user-supplied control and PCM ROM images. This fetcher downloads no Roland ROMs. An SF2 bank does not emulate MT-32 LA synthesis or SysEx patches.

sources.name: MuseScore SoundFont guide
sources.description: Official guide to other banks and formats, including FluidR3. The 2ine SoundFont backend accepts complete SF2 banks; SF3 and SFZ are different formats.

sources.name: FreePats
sources.description: Author/community source for openly licensed instrument samples and banks. Check coverage and per-bank license; a single instrument is not a complete GM set.
